title: Leases
description: The leases of your organization. A lease starts from a unit.
unitDescription: The leases of this unit. A new lease starts as a draft.
refused: The action could not be completed.

invalid.role: Choose the role of each person.
invalid.name: Enter the name of each person.
invalid.share: The share of the rent must be a percentage, for example 50 or 33.33.
invalid.amount: The maximum amount must be in dollars, for example 1500 or 1500.50.
invalid.terms: Accept the terms and the privacy policy to continue.
invalid.token: This invitation link is not valid.
invalid.dates: Enter valid dates (start, first payment and, if fixed, end).
invalid.rent: Rent and first payment must be in dollars, and the due day 1 to 28 or LAST.
invalid.payment: Choose at least one payment method.
invalid.clauseG: Check the situation, amount and dates of clause G.
invalid.clauseF: The clause F maximum rent must be in dollars.

refusals.shares: The shares of the rent must add up to 100%.
refusals.tenantRequired: A lease has at least one tenant.
refusals.contactRequired: Enter an email or a phone number for each tenant and guarantor.
refusals.emailInvalid: One of the emails is not valid.
refusals.nameRequired: Enter the name of each person.
refusals.tooMany: There are too many people on this lease.
refusals.afterSigning: After signing, tenants and guarantors can no longer change here. See "Lease events". Occupants can still be added or removed.
refusals.unknownTenant: A guarantor covers a tenant who is not on the lease.
refusals.notFound: This lease does not exist, or it does not belong to your organization.
refusals.unitNotFound: This unit does not exist, or it does not belong to your organization.
refusals.occupantNotFound: This occupant is not on the lease.
refusals.invitationExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new link.
refusals.invitationUsed: This invitation was already used. Sign in.
refusals.invitationAddress: This invitation was sent to another email address. Sign in with that one.
refusals.emailRequired: An email address is needed to invite this person.
refusals.overlap: This unit already has a signed or active lease for these dates.
refusals.termsInvalid: The terms have a blocking problem. See the findings below.
refusals.noTerms: Fill in the lease terms first.
refusals.outForSignature: The lease is out for signature: the terms no longer change here.
refusals.cannotCancel: This lease can no longer be cancelled here.
refusals.languageNotRequested: No English version was requested for this lease.
refusals.languageClosed: The lease is out for signature or signed: the language no longer changes.
refusals.ownChoiceOnly: Only a tenant or guarantor of the lease chooses the language, for themselves.

solidarity.title: Responsibility of the tenants
solidarity.help: With several tenants, choose whether each answers for the whole rent (solidary) or only for their share (joint).

parties.title: Parties to the lease
parties.description: Tenants, occupants and guarantors. People without an account are invited later.

occupants.title: Occupants
occupants.description: An occupant can be added or removed at any time, even after signing.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Invite the people on this lease to join Escalia. The link is valid for 30 days; sending again replaces the previous one.
invitations.sent: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody to invite: add an email to each person first.} one {# invitation sent.} other {# invitations sent.}}

accept.title: Join your lease
accept.description: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation, choose your language and accept the terms.
accept.terms: I accept the terms of use
accept.privacy: I have read the privacy policy
accept.requestSent: Your landlord was notified and will send a new link.
accept.noToken: This invitation link is not valid.

tenant.title: My leases
tenant.empty: You have not joined a lease yet.
tenant.pending: The terms appear here once the lease is signed.

terms.title: Lease terms
terms.description: Term, rent, payment, and clauses G and F. The rules check every change.
terms.locked: The lease is no longer a draft: the terms are fixed.
terms.acknowledge: I have read and accept this warning

clauseG.title: Clause G: lowest rent in the last 12 months
clauseG.help: The landlord states the lowest rent paid in the 12 months before the lease starts, or why it does not apply.

kinds.LOWEST_RENT: Lowest rent in the last 12 months
kinds.NOT_LEASED: Not leased in the last 12 months

clauseG.proposed: Proposal filled in from the rent history.
clauseG.noHistory: There is not enough history (12 months) to propose an amount.

clauseF.title: Clause F: fixed maximum rent
clauseF.help: Asked when the building is under 5 years old.

terms.previewNote: The preview is a working draft, not the official TAL form.

language.title: Lease language
language.description: The lease is written in French. If a tenant asks, they may choose to be bound by the English version after receiving the French version.
language.request: A tenant asks for the English version
language.requested: The English version was requested. Each tenant and guarantor chooses for themselves.
language.translationNote: Until everyone has chosen English, French binds the parties and the English version is a translation for information only.

choice.title: Langue du bail / Lease language
choice.question: Vous avez reçu le bail en français. Voulez-vous être lié(e) par la version anglaise ? / You received the lease in French. Do you want to be bound by the English version?
choice.keepFrench: Je garde la version française / I keep the French version
choice.wantEnglish: Je veux être lié(e) par la version anglaise / I want to be bound by the English version

done.fr: Vous gardez la version française. / You keep the French version.
done.en: Vous avez choisi la version anglaise. / You chose the English version.

choice.closed: Le bail est en signature ou signé : la langue ne change plus. / The lease is out for signature or signed: the language no longer changes.
choice.note: L'anglais ne lie les parties que si tous les locataires et toutes les cautions le choisissent. / English binds only if every tenant and guarantor chooses it.
